correctness.rationale: Cubical model hypotheses verified for all stated parameter values. Rational H1 is the graph-cycle module by equivariant chain projection and Ko–Park Theorem 3.16 rank equality; H2 follows from integer signed fixed-cell counts and the chain Lefschetz identity. Rational quotient ranks are calculated from exact fixed invariant cell orbits, including orientation-reversing stabilizers. Self-contained finite boundary computations reproduced three examples. Finite checks do not substitute for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Uniform exact characters and the surprising size-independent rank 3 binom(k,4) for full color-group quotient degree-two homology characterize a natural infinite family with large original top homology. The k=3 case rationally loses all second homology and retains a single rational cycle. These are motivated symmetry invariants not a routine isolated rank gain.
